QuestInfo.name: Cracking the Safe (3)
QuestInfo.2: You broke open the safe and its contents spilled out.

1.0: There's a ton of stuff here! But #eeuuugh#n! It reeks!\r\n
1.1: Now you'll be able to complete your mission. And my mission should also go s-s-moothly. Thank you, C-c-c-ca-ca-de-de-- Oh, you know what I'm trying to say!\r\n
1.2: S-safe cracking is a good skill to add to my r-resume! C-can't stop moving if I want to climb the ranks. Anyway, I'll see you b-back at the hideout. Good-bye!\r\n

0.msg: And he's gone. Yeesh, I'm glad stuttering isn't contagious. I'm not sure how much more of that I could take. Anyway, now the safe's cracked, I can finally collect.\r\n

default.0: I think you sh-sh-should open the safe. You're stronger than me, after all. Just p-pull hard on the handle.
